integrity: Analytic proof of transform inversion, endpoint atoms, and all-k asymptotics; 45 deterministic numerical checks of exact formulas. General closure, inversion framework and the k=2 benchmark are prior work, not independently new findings.
scientific_limitations: The result is confined to c=2, equal-weight Bernoulli input, integer multiplicative powers k>=3. It does not establish the conjectural random-matrix realization or noninteger powers. The k=2 logistic-Cauchy benchmark is subsumed by a squared pushforward of Mergny 2022 and is not assessed as new.
title: Higher polylogarithmic Mellin powers: a persistent half atom and sharp endpoint laws
